secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for the AI assistant (platform.openai.com/api-keys). Optional.

secrets.name: MERCADO_PAGO_PUBLIC_KEY
secrets.description: Mercado Pago public key (Developers > Credentials). Optional, only with PAYMENT_PROVIDER=mercadopago.

secrets.name: MERCADO_PAGO_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.description: Mercado Pago access token (Developers > Credentials). Optional.

secrets.name: MERCADO_PAGO_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Mercado Pago webhook secret signature. Optional.

secrets.name: SMTP_HOST
secrets.description: SMTP server for password-reset emails. Optional (reset URL is logged when unset).

secrets.name: SMTP_FROM
secrets.description: Sender address for outgoing emails. Optional.
